countries_thin_or_null: Bhutan — National Accounts and CPI exist and name SNA 2008 / COICOP, but detailed DSBB metadata pages and full methodology PDFs yield fewer independent release nodes than larger economies
Maldives — solid SNA 2008 and COICOP 2018 evidence from NBS publications, but limited additional flagship release detail beyond GDP and CPI series

proposed_reports.title: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics
proposed_reports.description: National statistical office responsible for compiling and disseminating national accounts, CPI, and other macroeconomic and socio-demographic statistics.

proposed_reports.title: National Accounts of Pakistan (2015-16 base)
proposed_reports.description: Annual and quarterly national accounts estimates (GDP, GNI, GFCF and related aggregates) compiled at current and constant prices with base year 2015-16.

proposed_reports.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI) Pakistan (2015-16 base)
proposed_reports.description: Monthly national, urban and rural Consumer Price Index series (and related indices) with base year 2015-16, using COICOP classification.

proposed_reports.title: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics
proposed_reports.publisher: Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh
proposed_reports.description: National statistical office responsible for national accounts, price statistics and socio-demographic data.

proposed_reports.title: National Accounts Statistics of Bangladesh (2015-16 base)
proposed_reports.description: GDP and related national accounts aggregates compiled by production and expenditure approaches under the 2008 SNA, with base year 2015-16.

proposed_reports.title: Department of Census and Statistics
proposed_reports.description: National statistical office authorized to compile and disseminate national accounts estimates and other official statistics for Sri Lanka.

proposed_reports.title: National Accounts Estimates of Sri Lanka (2015 base)
proposed_reports.description: Annual and quarterly GDP and related macroeconomic aggregates compiled under SNA 2008 with latest base year 2015.

proposed_reports.title: National Statistics Office (Nepal)
proposed_reports.description: Central statistical agency (renamed from Central Bureau of Statistics under the Statistics Act 2079 / 2022) responsible for national accounts, censuses and official statistics.

proposed_reports.title: National Accounts Statistics of Nepal
proposed_reports.description: GDP and related aggregates compiled by production and expenditure approaches following SNA 2008, with base year 2010/11 after the most recent rebasing.

proposed_reports.title: National Statistics Bureau
proposed_reports.description: National statistical office responsible for national accounts, CPI and other official statistics.

proposed_reports.title: National Accounts Statistics of Bhutan
proposed_reports.description: Annual GDP and related macroeconomic aggregates compiled in conformity with the United Nations System of National Accounts 2008 (UNSNA), with 2017 rebase.

proposed_reports.title: National Bureau of Statistics (Maldives)
proposed_reports.description: National statistical office responsible for national accounts, CPI and other official statistics.

proposed_reports.title: National Accounts of Maldives (2014 base)
proposed_reports.description: GDP estimates (production and expenditure) compiled under SNA 2008 with base year 2014, including SUT-based benchmarks.

proposed_reports.title: Consumer Price Index of Maldives
proposed_reports.description: Monthly CPI series classified according to COICOP 2018, with weights from household income and expenditure surveys.

dependencies.basis: PBS methodology and official statements explicitly name the 2008 SNA as the governing framework for national accounts compilation after the 2015-16 rebase.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Pakistan’s National Accounts estimates are prepared in the light of the UN System of National Accounts (SNA)-2008.

dependencies.basis: Pakistan participates in the IMF e-GDDS; the National Summary Data Page and DSBB metadata cover national accounts dissemination practices.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Pakistan — Enhanced General Data Dissemination System (e-GDDS) participant with National Accounts (GDP) category listed under the e-GDDS data categories.

dependencies.basis: PBS price statistics methodology and CPI item catalogue explicitly classify items under COICOP structure for the 2015-16 base series.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Classification Classification of Individual Consumption on Purpose (COICOP)

dependencies.basis: BBS publications on the 2015-16 rebase state that national accounts are compiled according to the concepts, definitions and classifications of the 2008 SNA.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The estimates are based on the concept, definition, classification and methodology of the best practice document “2008 System of National Accounts” (2008SNA).

dependencies.basis: Bangladesh participates in the IMF e-GDDS; DSBB lists national accounts under its e-GDDS dissemination practices.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Bangladesh — Enhanced General Data Dissemination System (e-GDDS) with National Accounts (GDP) category.

dependencies.basis: DCS official national accounts page and Sources & Methods document state that estimates follow the guidelines of SNA 2008.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Currently DCS follows the guidelines of system of National Accounts 2008 (SNA – 2008), which includes the latest set of boundaries, methodologies, concepts and recommendations.

dependencies.basis: Sri Lanka is an SDDS subscriber; the 2024 Annual Observance Report and DSBB confirm ongoing SDDS participation covering national accounts and other categories.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Sri Lanka subscribed to the SDDS on November 3, 2015, and met all the SDDS requirements at the time of subscription.

dependencies.basis: NSO national accounts publications and the Provincial GDP Manual state that compilation follows SNA 2008 after the 2010/11 rebase.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The concepts, definitions, classifications, and methodologies used in the compilation of national accounts statistics are guided by the recommendations of the System of National Accounts 2008 (SNA 2008).

dependencies.basis: Nepal implemented e-GDDS in 2017; DSBB and IMF press release confirm participation with NSDP covering national accounts.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Nepal has implemented the recommendations of the Enhanced General Data Dissemination System (e-GDDS) ... by publishing critical data through an upgraded version of the National Summary Data Page (NSDP).

dependencies.basis: NSB National Accounts Statistics reports explicitly state conformity with the United Nations System of National Accounts 2008.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The compilation methodology, definitions, and standards used in estimating the GDP conform to the United Nations System of National Accounts 2008 (UNSNA).

dependencies.basis: Bhutan implemented e-GDDS in 2017; NSDP is hosted on the NSB website and linked from the IMF DSBB.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Bhutan Implements the International Monetary Fund’s Enhanced General Data Dissemination System ... The NSDP is posted on the National Statistics Bureau’s website.

dependencies.basis: NBS methodology documents and DSBB metadata state that national accounts are based on SNA 2008 (base year 2014).
dependencies.evidence_quote: These national accounts are based on the United Nations, System of National Accounts (SNA 2008).

dependencies.basis: Maldives implemented e-GDDS in 2019; NSDP is hosted by the National Bureau of Statistics.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Maldives has implemented the recommendations of the IMF’s Enhanced General Data Dissemination System (e-GDDS) by publishing critical data through the National Summary Data Page (NSDP).

dependencies.basis: Official CPI guide states that COICOP 2018 has been used since the 2016 update.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The COICOP classification 2018 has been used since the 2016 CPI update. COICOP 2018 has 13 major divisions
